scope: Static opportunity audit. Every top-level installed mod artifact catalogued; relevant configs/resources and selected classes inspected. Not a full runtime compatibility certification. Nested JAR paths recorded, not counted as separate top-level mods.
version_note: Exact filenames and SHA-256 identify installed artifacts. Metadata may contain unresolved Forge placeholders or legacy labels; do not infer compatibility from a filename alone.
